title: 03 — Wilkołaki!
description: Gotowy Start Frame 1080×1920. Bez take’a. Planowany montaż: 3–3.75 s; 18 klatek / 24 fps. Planowany take: 3 s, wykorzystanie od początku. Ciasny portret Marcela, eyeline w lewo. Druga kwestia wyraźnie mocniejsza; szybkie cięcie i zmiana skali budują tempo. Bez dodatkowych słów i komediowych grymasów. Dokładne zmieszczenie słowa w 18 klatkach wymaga próby nagrania. Kamera: Nieruchomy ciasny portret; energię daje cięcie. Dialog do osobnego nagrania: Marcel, mocniej: „Wilkołaki!”. Start Frame wygenerowany wbudowanym generatorem i zweryfikowany. Animacja bez natywnego audio; wypowiedzi, lipsync i SFX opracować osobno. Wstawiono na V1 timeline: sekwencja 25 sekund, 24 fps.

prompts.image: Single photorealistic vertical 9:16 film still. Reference image 1 fixes exact identity, costume and location. New tight face close-up of MARCEL, the adult albino man with short white hair and tinted rectangular glasses seated on RIGHT of olive sofa. Frame crown to upper chest, his face dominates frame, same brown knitted cardigan, black shirt, D20 pendant. He looks toward SCREEN LEFT at his sister, with a firmer challenging expression, slightly leaning forward. Camera remains on TV side of dialogue axis. Same warm practical interior light and cool dusk through intact glass behind. Blurred same established zombie neighbours remain outside. No woman in crop. His Werewolf book is still in same right hand BELOW frame; don't force it into face shot. Natural skin, realistic eyeglasses with both eyes visible. No captions, text, watermark or collage. Preserve likeness precisely; this is another camera setup in the SAME scene.
prompts.animation: 0.0–0.75s: Marcel is already leaning a few centimetres forward from the first frame and finishes this one emphatic movement toward screen left. Camera: locked. Secondary motion: his knitted cardigan settles once. 0.75–3.0s: hold the forward posture with natural breathing; no further gesture or head turn. Continuity: preserve the supplied Start Frame identities, anatomy, clothing, prop geometry, furniture, lighting and existing lettering. No new people, duplicate bodies or props, extra limbs, morphing, cut, fade, captions or watermark. One continuous shot at normal speed.
